automation_evidence.quote: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to automate this process by combining code generation with evolutionary search

metric_evidence.quote: TradeGrad achieves the highest IS and OOS Scores among all compared strategy-design methods in all four settings.

evidence.quote: Emphasizing weak periods is more effective than optimizing mean or aggregate performance.

practical_problems.note: Table 3 ablates the cross-period lower-tail objective against mean-period and aggregate objectives and compares out-of-sample score on a chronological IS/OOS split. calibration: plain chronological IS/OOS split, no regime reported separately.

summary: TradeGrad automates LLM trading-program search with a cross-period robust objective; it beats strategy-design baselines out of sample and the objective ablation shows the lower-tail objective generalizes better than mean or aggregate ones.
